device.description: 24-bit 4-channel delta-sigma ADC with 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), 120 SPS at 2 MHz CLK
device.note: ads1224.pdf (SBAS286C) p.3-4 electrical characteristics (DVDD 2.7-5.5 V, data rate 120 SPS at fCLK = 2 MHz), p.5 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.13 data format and data retrieval, p.14 data retrieval timing (t4 = 50 ns, t7 = 8.32 ms), p.15 self-calibration, standby

registers.name: MUX
registers.note: internal: MUX1/MUX0 pin levels (Table 1, p.8); 0-3 = AINP1/AINN1 .. AINP4/AINN4

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the TEMPEN / BUFEN pin levels (pins.levels); no serial registers

pages: p.3-4 (EC), p.5 (pins), p.13-14 (data format, retrieval timing), p.15 (calibration, standby)
notModeled: analog inputs, buffer (BUFEN level stored only), temperature sensor (TEMPEN level stored only), reference
conversion time t7 = 8.32 ms (1 / data rate) at fCLK = 2 MHz; the data rate scales with CLK (120 SPS x fCLK / 2 MHz; the CLK pin is not used)
settling after a MUX0, MUX1, BUFEN or TEMPEN change: DRDY/DOUT held high for t1; the model just continues converting
DRDY/DOUT stays at the last data bit until the next update unless an extra SCLK forces it high; modeled as idle 1 after the data bits
self-calibration started by 26 SCLKs (the 25th forces DRDY/DOUT high, the 26th falling edge starts calibration)
standby mode (SCLK held high after DRDY/DOUT falls) and its wake-up
data-update window (no readback) and data overwritten if not read before the next update
